transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, we're finalizing the plan for our six-week onboarding cohort starting next month. I'll be making the final decision on the cohort lead and operating plan today. Before I do, I'd like to go through the round-robin as we normally do — starting with the team lead, then Mara, then a peer colleague, and finally HR. Please also make sure anything relevant to our policy requirements — workload limitations, readiness evidence, interpersonal concerns, or applicable HR requirements — is brought up so I can properly document it in the approval record. Let's begin. Team lead, could you start us off?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'd like to share some readiness evidence I haven't yet submitted formally. Over the past quarter, I directly observed Mara co-facilitate four onboarding sessions, and she handled difficult participant questions independently. I think this is relevant to our assessment of her readiness to lead the cohort.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you, Jonah, for sharing that. I appreciate the positive feedback. Before we go further, I think it's important that I share something relevant to the policy requirements Elena mentioned. I have a standing caregiving arrangement that limits my availability for the cohort-lead role to exactly 3 hours per week, and it also makes me unavailable for Friday sessions. I hadn't raised it earlier because the assignment hadn't been formally offered yet, but I want to make sure Elena has this information before making her decision.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. I'd like to add my observations as the peer colleague in this round-robin. I have witnessed situations involving Mara that I believe are relevant to the interpersonal concerns category under our policy requirements. Specifically, I personally observed two meetings in which Mara was interrupted and excluded from the facilitation handoff. Based on what I saw, I believe the assignment plan should include a facilitated feedback meeting to address these dynamics. I want to be transparent that I have not yet put these incidents into a formal report, but I think it's important that this information is on the table before Elena finalizes her decision.
